body.heading: Where in the world is South Sudan?
paragraphs: South Sudan is a country in Middle Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of South Sudan is Juba.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in South Sudan is English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of South Sudan is the South Sudanese pound.

body.heading: How big is South Sudan?
paragraphs: South Sudan covers about 620,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Mali.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Boma hosts one of the world's largest animal migrations — millions of white-eared kob antelope and other antelopes move across its vast grasslands each year.
Where the White Nile rushes through rapids at the Ugandan border, Nimule's riverine forest shelters elephants and hippos along the great river.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find South Sudan on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: South Sudan in one breath: a country in Middle Africa, capital Juba, where people speak English and pay with the South Sudanese pound.
